claims.claim: Social Status is a Charlotte-rooted sneaker boutique with an open Charlotte store, used as the first-release door for the Hive recut.

sources.title: Here’s what a $1,000 pair of sneakers from Social Status looks like

claims.evidence: Axios (2018) says Social Status calls its Plaza Midwood store on Central Avenue its flagship and Charlotte its home city. A Charlotte Magazine listing (2020 awards) gives 1519 Central Ave. No result shows the store is open in 2026, and none covers the Nike account.
claims.action: No change. Confirm the store is open and the Nike account is active before launch.

sources.title: NIKE Factory Store - Concord, North Carolina NC 28027 - Concord Mills

claims.evidence: A directory lists a Nike Factory Store at 8111 Concord Mills Blvd, last updated April 2022. A Nike job post and a Nike locator page refer to a Nike clearance store at Concord Mills, at a different address. Nothing current settles which Nike format is open there now.
claims.action: No change. Confirm whether the Concord Mills door is a Nike Factory Store or a Nike Clearance Store, and that it is open.
